spans.s:
√mṛḍ 'be gracious'
present: [6.] mṛḍáti etc. mṛḍáse -- [9.] mṛḍnāti 
perfect: mamarḍa mamṛḍyus 
[aorist: amīmṛḍat amamarḍat amarḍīt marḍiṣyati marḍitā ]
secondary: intensive: marīmṛḍ- -- desiderative: mimarḍiṣa- -- causative: mṛḍáyati etc. mṛḍáyate 
derivatives: mṛḍa B.+ mṛḍana C. mṛḍīká V.+ marḍitṛ́ RV. mṛḍitṛ́ AV. -mṛḍaya B. mṛḍayā́ku RV. -mṛdya C.
